items.title: z_goal / residue_wanting -> behaviour coupling, RE-INSTRUMENTED (per-seed non-degeneracy, variance+base-rate admissibility, pre-registered z_goal seeding dose)
items.note: DIAGNOSTIC / OBSERVATIONAL -- claim_ids=[], experiment_purpose=diagnostic; promotes nothing, weights no governance. Lettered re-instrument of V3-EXQ-932 per failure_autopsy_931-932-wanting-authority-cluster_2026-08-16 (human gate CONFIRMED 2026-08-16T18:41:10Z, governance-applied 2026-08-16) Section 8. 932's MEASUREMENT-VALIDITY PASS STANDS and is NOT superseded; what is repaired is its reported, non-gating coupling narrative, of which only wanting->moved(t+1) survived autopsy re-analysis. REPAIRS (autopsy items 1-5): (1) non-degeneracy predicate is MIN-across-seeds, not MAX -- the specific defect that let seed 2 alone certify z_goal for all three; chan_max_std still emitted REPORTED-ONLY for 932/916a comparability. (2) `powered` now certifies VARIANCE and BASE RATE, not just n: every coupling lands in settled | underpowered_n | unsettable_x_degenerate | unsettable_dv_degenerate, and a non-settled coupling emits r=null, NEVER 0.0 -- so 932's structural 0.0 on a zero-variance DV can no longer read as a measured null. (3) pre-registered base-rate floors MIN_DV_POSITIVES=20 / MIN_DV_BASE_RATE=0.05 (per-seed 10 / same rate), which against 932's realised rates refuse harm_signal>0 (6/1013) and reef_exit (10/1013) while admitting moved (103/1013) and benefit_exposure (220/1013). (4) both mode-based *_to_approach_t1 DVs DROPPED from the gating set (retained REPORTED-ONLY for 906c comparability) plus a NEW precedence-free `approach_raw`, so the drop rests on the event's own base rate rather than on _classify_mode's affect precedence. (5) the z_goal regime is addressed by a pre-registered 2-arm dose on ONE documented knob, MECH-187 goal.z_goal_seeding_gain: ARM_G1_EMERGENT=1.0 (932's operating point, byte-identical) vs ARM_G4_SEEDED=4.0. NOT 931's forced every-tick update_z_goal(0.5,0.9), which was rejected because a force-seeded z_goal is a lagged z_world EMA whose coupling to behaviour would be an artifact of the forcing. ALSO IMPLEMENTED (autopsy items 3-4, which the autopsy says need NO re-run and are therefore NOT this run's compute justification -- they are free once the driver runs): per-seed couplings + a Fisher-z within-seed pooled estimate beside every pooled figure, and partial correlations against the third channel, which the 932 driver computed nowhere. WHY THE COMPUTE IS JUSTIFIED: only autopsy items 1, 2 and 5 need a run -- getting z_goal live on more than one seed, and variance-based admissibility -- the rest is recoverable from 932's committed episode log. GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readouts are the per-seed coupling admissibility statuses and the z_goal active fraction under a CHANGED seeding gain. Checked v3_exq_932_zgoal_wanting_coupling_reinstrument_20260814T155424Z_v3 and its episode log: the log answers the per-seed/partialling half (and that half is not re-run for), but no recorded manifest carries ANY run at a non-default z_goal_seeding_gain, so the dose contrast is not recoverable -> run. GOV-FANOUT-1 / V3-EXQ-785: ARM_G1_EMERGENT is EXPECTED to have a flat z_goal, so the z_goal preconditions are applies_to-SCOPED to the seeded arm and the run's non_degenerate is aggregate_arm_gates' ANY-arm-green, never all-arms-green -- a red arm cannot vacate a green one. DV-SYMMETRY (per arm, both arms): the manipulation is a positive MULTIPLIER inside the strict inequality effective_benefit > benefit_threshold in GoalState.update. It is not a broadcast additive constant (it never enters candidate scoring), not a monotone rescaling of a rank-based DV (the DVs are threshold-crossing counts and channel magnitudes, not orderings), and not a permutation of interchangeable units -- so no DV symmetry annihilates it. The one way it could be vacuous (no step clears the threshold even at gain 4, making the arms bit-identical) is measured by the pre-registered z_goal_dose_separation precondition. STEP 2.5c substrate-path overlap settled by RUNTIME PROBE, not module-name matching: mode-governance-engagement (corrupting, lists ree_core/agent.py) -- probed use_salience_coordinator=False and agent.salience_coordinator is None, so the SalienceCoordinator affinity-clamp path is never instantiated; this driver's `mode` DV is its own _classify_mode affect-precedence chain, a different quantity. contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy (corrupting, ree_core/predictors/e1_deep.py) -- probed by monkeypatch-counting over a real 66-step run of this exact config: ContextMemory.write() called 0 times (read() 132), so the defective hard-argmin write path is not on this driver's execution path. Both probes are recorded in the module docstring and are cheap to repeat. SMOKE: PASS. Extended smoke (2 arms x 2 seeds, 10 warmup x 100 steps) exercised every new path: both arms green, z_goal dose_separation 0.981 (active_frac 0.0000 -> 0.9815), wanting_t_to_moved_t1 settled in both arms, and every rare-event DV correctly refused with r=null. It also CAUGHT a real design flaw before queuing -- the per-seed estimates initially reused the pooled n>=200 floor, which would have refused seed 2 of 932's own run (n=186) and made the within-seed estimator unmeasurable; fixed with separate pre-registered per-seed floors. With those, within-seed pooled r for wanting->moved is +0.372 against a POOLED -0.106 -- opposite signs, i.e. the instrument now surfaces the between-seed artifact that previously took an autopsy to find, and +0.372 sits essentially on 932's reported +0.373. validate_experiments.py --strict: OK, 0 warnings in every category.
